ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a transition-state structure with R2 attached by a single bond to an upper-left carbon. That carbon is bonded to a left oxygen and has a C=N double bond to the central positively charged nitrogen. The nitrogen is also singly bonded to R1 above, to R on the right, and to a lower carbon. The lower carbon is singly bonded to the left oxygen and to a right oxygen. Curved arrows and charge symbols are present but are not counted as bonds. Reasoning: The non-hydrogen bonds to count are C-R2 single, C-O-left single, C=N double, N-R1 single, N-R single, N-bottom-carbon single, bottom-carbon-O-left single, and bottom-carbon-O-right single. There are seven single bonds, contributing 7, and one double bond, contributing 2. Total bond count by bond order is 7 + 2 = 9.
